label: D2 after reaching S2, in a high-value, strongly-a2 state (mid-episode)
explanation: About 95% of activation mass is at D2 steps where S2 is the state shown (nearly always after choosing a2, mostly common transitions). It never fires at D1, and it fires only weakly at GO (5% of mass). Within S2-D2 steps it fires sparsely, on about 5%. Firing concentrates where the model value is in its top bin (>8.1, 92% of mass), where the policy logit strongly favours a2 (choice -8.9 to -4.4), and in episode trials 10-50, with almost no firing after trial 55. It is also more frequent when S2 is the hidden good state and the episode started with S2 bad. The top activations are rare a1->S2 trials after an a2 streak in which S2 was good and rewarded. The recorded predicate (D2 & state S2 & value>8.1 & choice<-4.44) uses only observed or internal variables. On dev it gets precision 0.28, recall 0.84, mass recall 0.89. Precision stays low: most matching steps are inactive, so which ones fire depends on hidden state not captured by these variables. It does not fire after S1 is reached, after an a1 choice with a common transition, or late in the episode.
